test_case.description: Appium test for a deep Canva mobile flow: open Canva, search for a design type, create a design, add/edit content, preview sharing/export options, and return safely. Runtime device and app capabilities are supplied by Executor-Regenerator.

prerequisites.description: Canva app is installed and the user is already signed in. Executor-Regenerator supplies the Appium capabilities for the selected local, BrowserStack, or Sauce device.

steps.description: Verify that the Canva home screen is displayed.
steps.expected_outcome: The Canva home screen or Home tab is visible.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='Home' or @content-desc='Home' or @label='Home' or @name='Home']")
assert element.is_displayed()

steps.description: Open the Canva search field.
steps.expected_outcome: The search input is focused.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[contains(@text, 'Search') or contains(@content-desc, 'Search') or contains(@label, 'Search') or contains(@name, 'Search')]")
element.click()

steps.description: Search for Instagram Post templates.
steps.expected_outcome: Instagram Post is typed into the search field.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[contains(@text, 'Search') or contains(@content-desc, 'Search') or contains(@label, 'Search') or contains(@name, 'Search')]")
element.send_keys("Instagram Post")

steps.description: Tap the Instagram Post search suggestion.
steps.expected_outcome: Canva opens Instagram Post search results.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[contains(@text, 'Instagram Post') or contains(@content-desc, 'Instagram Post') or contains(@label, 'Instagram Post') or contains(@name, 'Instagram Post')]")
element.click()

steps.description: Verify that Instagram Post results are displayed.
steps.expected_outcome: The Instagram Post results page is visible.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[contains(@text, 'Instagram Post') or contains(@content-desc, 'Instagram Post') or contains(@label, 'Instagram Post') or contains(@name, 'Instagram Post')]")
assert element.is_displayed()

steps.description: Choose a blank Instagram Post design.
steps.expected_outcome: A blank design canvas opens.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[contains(@text, 'Blank') or contains(@content-desc, 'Blank') or contains(@label, 'Blank') or contains(@name, 'Blank')]")
element.click()

steps.description: Verify that the Canva editor canvas is open.
steps.expected_outcome: The editor toolbar or Add button is visible.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='Add' or @content-desc='Add' or @label='Add' or @name='Add' or @content-desc='Plus' or @name='Plus']")
assert element.is_displayed()

steps.description: Open the Add panel.
steps.expected_outcome: The Add panel opens with design element options.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='Add' or @content-desc='Add' or @label='Add' or @name='Add' or @content-desc='Plus' or @name='Plus']")
element.click()

steps.description: Open the Text option from the Add panel.
steps.expected_outcome: Text insertion options are displayed.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='Text' or @content-desc='Text' or @label='Text' or @name='Text']")
element.click()

steps.description: Add a heading text element.
steps.expected_outcome: A heading text box is added to the design.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[contains(@text, 'Heading') or contains(@content-desc, 'Heading') or contains(@label, 'Heading') or contains(@name, 'Heading')]")
element.click()

steps.description: Select the inserted heading text box.
steps.expected_outcome: The heading text box is selected for editing.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[contains(@text, 'Heading') or contains(@text, 'Your text') or contains(@content-desc, 'Heading') or contains(@label, 'Heading') or contains(@name, 'Heading')]")
element.click()

steps.description: Replace the heading with campaign text.
steps.expected_outcome: The heading reads Summer Launch.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@class='android.widget.EditText' or @type='XCUIElementTypeTextView' or @type='XCUIElementTypeTextField']")
element.clear()
element.send_keys("Summer Launch")

steps.description: Confirm the text edit.
steps.expected_outcome: The edited heading is committed to the canvas.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='Done' or @content-desc='Done' or @label='Done' or @name='Done' or @text='Apply' or @content-desc='Apply']")
element.click()

steps.description: Open the Add panel again.
steps.expected_outcome: The Add panel is available for adding another element.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='Add' or @content-desc='Add' or @label='Add' or @name='Add' or @content-desc='Plus' or @name='Plus']")
element.click()

steps.description: Open Elements from the Add panel.
steps.expected_outcome: Canva Elements options are displayed.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='Elements' or @content-desc='Elements' or @label='Elements' or @name='Elements']")
element.click()

steps.description: Search elements for star.
steps.expected_outcome: Star is entered in the elements search field.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[contains(@text, 'Search') or contains(@content-desc, 'Search') or contains(@label, 'Search') or contains(@name, 'Search')]")
element.send_keys("star")

steps.description: Select a star element from the results.
steps.expected_outcome: A star graphic is added to the design.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[contains(@text, 'star') or contains(@text, 'Star') or contains(@content-desc, 'star') or contains(@content-desc, 'Star') or contains(@label, 'Star') or contains(@name, 'Star')]")
element.click()

steps.description: Open the share or export menu.
steps.expected_outcome: The share/export options sheet opens.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='Share' or @content-desc='Share' or @label='Share' or @name='Share' or @content-desc='Export' or @name='Export']")
element.click()

steps.description: Verify that the Download option is available.
steps.expected_outcome: Download appears in the share/export menu.

matched_script.raw_code:
element = driver.find_element(AppiumBy.XPATH, "//*[@text='Download' or @content-desc='Download' or @label='Download' or @name='Download']")
assert element.is_displayed()

steps.description: Close the share/export menu and return to the editor.
steps.expected_outcome: The Canva editor is displayed again without starting a download.

matched_script.raw_code: driver.back()
